fr:frontmatter.fr:meta: @article{thompsonProgrammingTechniquesRegular1968, title = {Programming {Techniques}: {Regular} expression search algorithm}, author = {Thompson, Ken}, year = {1968}, doi = {10.1145/363347.363387}, url = {https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/363347.363387}, urldate = {2024-04-29}, journal = {Communications of the ACM}, volume = {11}, number = {6}, pages = {419--422}, file = {Full Text PDF:/Users/stevenschaefer/Zotero/storage/6FRSL8GN/Thompson - 1968 - Programming Techniques Regular expression search .pdf:application/pdf}, month = {June}, language = {en}, abstract = {A method for locating specific character strings embedded in character text is described and an implementation of this method in the form of a compiler is discussed. The compiler accepts a regular expression as source language and produces an IBM 7094 program as object language. The object program then accepts the text to be searched as input and produces a signal every time an embedded string in the text matches the given regular expression. Examples, problems, and solutions are also presented.}, shorttitle = {Programming {Techniques}}, issn = {0001-0782, 1557-7317} }
